text:
maria_support: Hey team, customer on /v1/embeddings-prod is seeing p99 tail spikes ~1.2s intermittently and occasional dimension-mismatch 400s. Started after we bumped max_batch_size to 64 last week. Repro steps attached.

jake_engineer: thanks, can you paste a minimal repro? which model variant and client SDK?

maria_support: Model: open-embed-1536-v2 (hosted). SDK: python client 0.9.2. Repro: send 120 small texts (50-150 chars) concurrently via org's API key. Curl example:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
 -d '{"model":"open-embed-1536-v2","input":["short text"]*120}'
```

maria_support: Typical response when dim error happens:

```json
{"error":{"message":"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536 but received 1024","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

anya_oncall: hmm, dimension mismatch + tail spikes could be two issues. Do we have any batching logs from the serving runtime at the time?

maria_support: customer gave trace id: trace_0a9f. They hit it around 2026-03-12T14:21:03Z. I pulled partial logs from their request window, see below.

sam_research: dropping logs excerpt — note: redacted keys

```
[2026-03-12T14:21:02.998Z] shard=embed-3 batch_id=9876 size=64 route=open-embed-1536-v2
[2026-03-12T14:21:03.001Z] batch_coalesce: window_ms=6 queued=120 -> flush size=64
[2026-03-12T14:21:03.002Z] exec: kernel=quant-fused, seq_len=128, allocated_kv=...
[2026-03-12T14:21:03.120Z] send_partial_responses for 63/64
[2026-03-12T14:21:03.201Z] send_error for 1/64: dim_mismatch expected=1536 got=1024
[2026-03-12T14:21:03.210Z] flush remainder batch size=56 -> queued_wait 180ms (tailing)
[2026-03-12T14:21:03.380Z] total_latency p99 ~1.21s
```

sam_research: looks like a mixed-variant routing issue: some requests in the same coalesce window were routed to a different variant (maybe open-embed-1024-vx) causing the dim mismatch. The batch then stalled waiting for missing items which explains tail latency.

jake_engineer: good catch. Do we have any recent routing changes or model alias shuffles? Ops metadata?

ops-bot: deploy event: 2026-03-10T03:12Z - model-catalog sync. Changes: added alias open-embed-latest -> open-embed-1024-vx (deprecated 1024).

anya_oncall: that alias could be the culprit if client sometimes specifies vague model names or we fallback. Customer said they set model param to "open-embed-1536-v2" explicitly though. Could SDK fallback rewrite occur?

maria_support: customer pasted the request body — they do send exact name. But their request goes through a proxy that rewrites model param sometimes for multi-tenant routing. That proxy was updated last week (PR #612).

jake_engineer: action plan: 1) reproduce locally with coalesce window shortened/lengthened, 2) add extra logging for model_variant per request in coalesce window, 3) temporary mitigation: reduce max_batch_size to 16 for that route and set strict variant matching to reject mixed variants instead of coalescing.

sam_research: reproduced locally by sending concurrent requests that hit two routing rules; with max_batch_size=64 we saw one-off 400s dim errors and p99 jump. With max_batch_size=16 p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 210ms and no dim errors.

jake_engineer: can we patch serving to refuse coalescing mixed-variant batches? Might be safer to fail fast than produce dim errors.

anya_oncall: yes, we have a config flag batch.strict_variant_match=false by default. Flip to true for embeddings routes as emergency. I'll stage a rollout to canary 2 nodes now.

deploy-bot: rollout start: batch.strict_variant_match=true for service=embeddings shard=eu-west-1 canary=2

maria_support: customer wants a workaround in the meanwhile — can we recommend they set max_batch_size=8 from client side? Or will that break throughput?

sam_research: recommending client-side max_batch_size reduction is fine as temporary mitigation. Also recommend setting coalesce_window_ms=8 and use pinned model id (not alias) to avoid proxy rewrites.

jake_engineer: I'll open an internal ticket to audit alias mappings and proxy rewrite rules (TICKET-8483). Also will add a quick check in the runtime to log per-request variant id when coalescing window opens.

maria_support: replied to customer with mitigation steps and ETA for patch. Customer will try reducing client batch and confirm.

anya_oncall: follow-up: after canary roll, monitor p99 and dim-error rate. If stable, promote to 100% in 10m.

ops-bot: canary metrics snapshot: p99 embeddings route before=1.18s after-canary=0.23s dim_error rate before=0.6% after=0.0%

maria_support: customer confirmed reduced batching removed dim errors, tail back under 300ms. Marking support escalation resolved but leaving ticket open until full rollout. :thumbsup:

jake_engineer: long term: we should treat model_variant id as part of coalesce key (variant_id + model_arch + quant). Avoid alias-only keys. Filing RFC.

sam_research: also worth adding a periodic audit that flags newly added aliases that point to mixed-dim variants. Might catch future regressions.

maria_support: thanks everyone. I'll update the support ticket with logs and the workaround notes./thread
